candidates.explanation: Pipeline-aware relaxation with downstream protection. When total pipeline is high relative to recent delivered demand, cut orders modestly, but only if local backlog is low; if backlog exists, do not cut. When pipeline is low and backlog is positive, raise orders to protect service. Corrections are small and coordinated across nodes.

Backlog-sensitive smoothing. Increase orders when backlog is high and pipeline is low, but avoid over-ordering when pipeline already covers demand. Downstream service is protected by limiting cuts when backlog is present.

Growth-adaptive damping. When recent delivered demand exceeds baseline, slightly increase orders to avoid stockouts; when pipeline is excessive relative to growth, reduce cautiously. Keeps corrections small and coordinated.

rules.when: growth > 1.2 and pipeline < recent and backlog > 0
